name: build-product
job: Ship a missing product capability end-to-end as an owning-boundary vertical slice with original-oracle proof.

inScope: Framing the journey/capability gap and done look
Implementing the full owning-boundary vertical slice of the core concept
Applying the Quality North Star and risk-matched verification on the framed path
Landing source with atomic commits and a revert-safe PR outcome
outOfScope: Below-threshold polish, speculative features, and drive-by rewrites
Whole-product completion claims beyond the framed slice

inputs: Product, journey/capability, and done look for this cycle
Constraints: platforms, auth, data, engine versus product boundary
Current failure evidence from code, build, live, and docs
outputs: Framed capability usable under a stated original oracle
Original-oracle verification (run, smoke, API, pack, host as applicable)
Honest residuals list with ownership of changes

tools: development environment and CI for the target platform
data: current failure evidence and domain constraints
permissions: write access on the owning layer or a PR path into it

failureSemantics: No permanent workarounds: gaps resolve on the owning layer; a slice is done only when the framed capability is usable under the stated oracle or only externally blocked, residuals are listed, and no known ship-blocker was ignored.

outcome.observable: The framed capability works end-to-end under its stated original oracle with separated local versus landed versus live claims, and residuals are listed without whole-product completion claims.
